title: QA Workbench Review Decision Receipt
description: Schema for a governed workbench review decision receipt. Records an Owner review disposition over a decision summary. Does not approve intake, verify evidence, close workbench items, seal work, mutate source records, or create autonomous authority.

receipt_id.description: Unique workbench decision receipt identifier (e.g. WDR-ACTION-0001).

source_summary_id.description: The decision summary ID that this receipt was created from.

source_intake_id.description: The intake record ID that this receipt references.

relevant_item_ids.description: Workbench item IDs relevant to this decision.

decision.description: Owner decision disposition. accepted_for_action means the item is accepted for further action — not that defects are accepted or evidence is verified. authorized means Owner authorizes the recommended action. deferred means postponed. rejected means declined.

rationale.description: Owner rationale for the decision. Must not imply approval, verification, or seal authority.

recorded_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the receipt was recorded.

source_summary_timestamp.description: Optional timestamp from the source decision summary.

authority_disclaimer.const: A workbench review decision receipt records an Owner review disposition over a decision summary. It does not approve intake, verify evidence, close workbench items, seal work, mutate source records, or create autonomous authority. Custody is qa-pilot-local. Librarian impact is none.
authority_disclaimer.description: Standard authority disclaimer. Must match exactly.

advisory_only.description: Must always be true. Receipts are advisory-only.
